meta.name: user-story
meta.description: Create user stories with Mike Cohn format and Gherkin acceptance criteria. Use when turning user needs into development-ready work with clear outcomes and testable conditions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将用户需求转化为开发就绪的用户故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把模糊的用户需求变成结构化的开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn user needs into development-ready user stories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague user needs into structured development tasks

howto.what: Claude 会按照 Mike Cohn 格式（As a / I want / so that）编写用户故事，并附带 Gherkin 格式（Given/When/Then）的验收标准。它会引导你明确用户角色、目标和可测试的成功条件。
howto.when: 当你需要将用户需求转化为开发任务，或要求编写带有验收标准的用户故事时触发。例如，你说“写一个用户故事”或“把需求转成故事”。

say.text: 为我们的B2B SaaS应用写一个通知系统的用户故事。
say.note: Claude 会生成故事和验收标准。

say.text: 把这个PRD需求转成带Gherkin验收标准的用户故事。
say.note: Claude 会解析需求并输出格式化的故事。

howto.what_en: Claude writes user stories in Mike Cohn format (As a / I want / so that) with Gherkin acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then). It guides you to define user role, goal, and testable success conditions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to turn user needs into development-ready stories or ask for stories with acceptance criteria. For example, saying 'write a user story' or 'convert this requirement into a story'.

say_en.text: Write a user story for a notification system in our B2B SaaS app.
say_en.note: Claude generates story and acceptance criteria.

say_en.text: Convert this PRD requirement into a user story with Gherkin acceptance criteria.
say_en.note: Claude parses the requirement and outputs a formatted story.
